summary: Planned the implementation in verifiable order: typed contracts and defaults, real-SQLite atomic admission and race coverage, bounded provider controller and live revalidation, server/RPC/CLI integration, project Manage controls, documentation, package checks, local install/reload, and desktop/mobile browser evidence.

state.request: Build an autonomous software factory into the existing Taskboard plugin, inspired by https://github.com/lpbaril/bb-plugin-factory. Make Linear, Jira, or the configured issue provider the source of truth. The factory should continuously select eligible tickets, start and supervise BB agent work, avoid duplicate dispatch, recover after restart, and reflect progress back through the existing Taskboard provider/status model. Reuse the current taskboard architecture and keep the first implementation focused and operable.

sizeDecision.reason: The eight criteria describe one atomic queue-admission capability: settings, durable claim, scheduler, status, UI, and verification share one project policy and cannot ship independently without either exposing an inert control or allowing uncontrolled admission.
